language_task: Put the spoon in the drawer.
outcome_evidence: The spoon starts on the table beside the plate (frame 0, image and left_ego_image). The robot grasps and lifts it, with retention visible during transport (frames 60–100, left_ego_image and wrist_image). It releases the spoon into the open drawer (frames 124–128, image and wrist_image); the spoon rests inside as the empty gripper withdraws (frames 129–135, wrist_image). No failed acquisition or unintended side effect is visible.
